userStories.title: 2FA: secrets, TOTP and recovery codes (library and schema)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need TOTP two-factor building blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `user_totp` (user_id unique, secret_encrypted, confirmed_at, created_at) and `recovery_codes` (user_id, code_hash, used_at) with a migration and cascade from users; the secret is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key from env `TWOFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (documented in `.env.example`; tests set it with `vi.stubEnv`; the code refuses to enable 2FA when it is unset)
`lib/auth/totp.ts` implements RFC 6238 TOTP (SHA-1, 6 digits, 30 s, +/-1 step window) with no new dependency, plus otpauth URI creation; unit test uses the RFC test vectors
10 recovery codes are generated randomly, shown once, stored only as hashes and each works once
Verification attempts are rate limited per user through the existing rate-limit interface
Tests pass (npm run lint, typecheck and test are green)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 2FA: login step and enrolment API
userStories.description: As a member, I want to turn on 2FA and be asked for the code when I log in.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints to start enrolment (returns otpauth URI and secret), confirm with a first code (then returns the recovery codes once), and disable (needs password and a valid code)

Login with 2FA enabled returns a short-lived pending-2FA token instead of a session; a second endpoint accepts a TOTP or a recovery code and then sets the normal session cookie; wrong codes are rate limited and never reveal which part failed
Existing sessions are not affected by enabling 2FA; disabling 2FA and using a recovery code set `sessions_valid_after` for other devices
Tests: enrol, login with code, login with recovery code (second use rejected), disable, rate limit
Tests pass (npm run lint, typecheck and test are green)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Audit log: table and writer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an append-only record of sensitive actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `audit_log` (id, workspace_id nullable, actor_user_id nullable, actor_label, action, target_type, target_id, metadata jsonb, ip, created_at) with a migration, cascade from workspaces, an index on (workspace_id, created_at), and database triggers that reject UPDATE and DELETE except through the workspace cascade

`recordAudit(db, {...})` in `lib/audit.ts` is the only writer; it strips a deny-list of keys (password, token, secret, key, text, note) from metadata and never stores request bodies; failures to write are logged without content and do not break the request
Tests: append works, update and delete are rejected, deny-list stripping, cascade from workspace
Tests pass (npm run lint, typecheck and test are green)
Typecheck passes
